lines.x: Brent crude futures rose toward $93 a barrel and WTI gained 0.56% to $82.90 following reported Houthi missile attacks near Riyadh and tanker disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.
A Riyadh skyscraper housing the headquarters of Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund sustained damage from a new missile strike launched by Yemen's Houthis.
Foreign investors purchased 34.9 million shares valued at SR786 million on Tadawul, increasing holdings in 131 companies during the week ended Nov 19.
Saudi Arabia's Tadawul All Share Index closed 1.95% lower, driven down by declines across listed domestic equities.
